# Test DOWN - should modify blue bar symbol at position 0
# First record current blue[0] pattern
ascii_before = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def extract_pattern(lines, rstart, rend, cstart, cend):
    pattern = set()
    for r in range(rstart, rend+1):
        for c in range(cstart, cend+1):
            if lines[r][c] == 'B':
                pattern.add((r-rstart, c-cstart))
    return frozenset(pattern)

blue0_before = extract_pattern(ascii_before, 40, 46, 14, 20)

action(['DOWN'])

ascii_after = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
blue0_after = extract_pattern(ascii_after, 40, 46, 14, 20)

print(f"Blue[0] changed: {blue0_before != blue0_after}")
print(f"Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
print(f"Gameplay changed: {last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# Check all current matches
lines = ascii_after
top_patterns = {}
for ri, (rstart, rend) in enumerate([(4,10), (13,19), (22,28)]):
    for ci, (cstart, cend) in enumerate([(12,18), (22,28), (35,41), (45,51)]):
        pat = extract_pattern(lines, rstart, rend, cstart, cend)
        top_patterns[(ri, ci)] = pat

blue_patterns = {}
for si in range(5):
    cstart = 14 + si * 7
    cend = cstart + 6
    pat = extract_pattern(lines, 40, 46, cstart, cend)
    blue_patterns[si] = pat

pink_patterns = {}
for si in range(5):
    cstart = 14 + si * 7
    cend = cstart + 6
    pat = extract_pattern(lines, 51, 57, cstart, cend)
    pink_patterns[si] = pat

print("\n=== ALL matches (after DOWN) ===")
for si, bpat in blue_patterns.items():
    for (ri, ci), tpat in top_patterns.items():
        if bpat == tpat:
            print(f"  Blue[{si}] matches Top[{ri},{ci}]")

for si, ppat in pink_patterns.items():
    for (ri, ci), tpat in top_patterns.items():
        if ppat == tpat:
            print(f"  Pink[{si}] matches Top[{ri},{ci}]")
